facts.value: As the physics callback referenced by slots 1 and 3 of it_803F8200, receives an item GObj, obtains its Item and xCC_item_attr, and forwards the unchanged GObj with x10_fall_speed and x14_fall_speed_max to it_80272860. That helper conditionally subtracts the acceleration argument from x40_vel.y according to velocity direction and magnitude.
